posts.mainText: Sen. Bernie Sanders announced the Artificial Intelligence Data Center Moratorium Act on March 25, halting construction of AI data centers until safeguards address climate, privacy, and safety risks.
posts.replyText: Drives legislative coordination on AI infrastructure impacts, legitimizing calls for equitable safety measures amid rapid expansion.

posts.mainText: Meta, NVIDIA, Oracle, and Google joined President-elect Trump's AI Advisory Council to counsel on policy and regulation, marking a shift to industry-government partnership.
posts.replyText: Enhances coordination between tech leaders and executive, but risks legitimacy via perceived capture, sidelining safety advocates.

posts.mainText: White House released National AI Legislative Framework on March 20, proposing federal preemption of state laws and oversight by existing agencies for unified governance.
posts.replyText: Prevents regulatory patchwork, promoting cross-sector coordination and legitimacy through principles-based, non-bureaucratic approach.
